description:
What CBP's rulings quote and decide on a heading: for deciding whether a product falls in it.
    Give the product to get what decides for it first. `passages`: the lines rulings quote when
    deciding (mostly from the WCO Explanatory Notes, not published free; fragments, not the whole
    note), each with the rulings
    that quote it: their goods, HQ or NY, date, status and what CBP concluded; `exclusion` marks
    text on what the heading does not cover. `notes_applied`: the legal notes rulings applied to
    the heading. `cited_without_quote`: rulings that relied on its explanatory note without quoting
    it. Each passage is as a ruling quotes it.

heading.description: An HTS heading (9505) or any code under it (9505.10.25).
heading.title: Heading

product.description: The product in plain words. Puts first the passages and rulings on goods closest to it: what decides for this product, not what is quoted most.
product.title: Product
